questions.question: Which observational discovery fundamentally challenged the long-held paradigm that most Ultraluminous X-ray Sources (ULXs) harbor intermediate-mass black holes (10^2 to 10^4 solar masses)?
options: The detection of coherent X-ray pulsations from M82 X-2 using the NuSTAR observatory
The measurement of relativistic iron K-alpha line broadening in NGC 1313 X-1
The discovery of optical counterparts matching O-type supergiant stars in Holmberg IX X-1
The observation of radio jets exhibiting apparent superluminal motion in SS 433

questions.question: In radio interferometry and Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI), what is the primary diagnostic advantage of constructing 'closure phases' across a triplet of antennas?
options: It eliminates baseline-dependent geometric delays, allowing absolute positional astronomy.
It cancels out antenna-based phase errors caused by atmospheric turbulence and local oscillator drift.
It increases the effective bandwidth of the array, improving sensitivity by the square root of the number of baselines.
It removes non-thermal synchrotron self-absorption effects from compact core sources.

questions.question: A massive star entering the Wolf-Rayet phase exhibits strong emission lines of carbon (C III, C IV) and oxygen, but a complete absence of hydrogen and nitrogen lines. What evolutionary process accounts for this 'WC' spectral classification?
options: The star is in its early main-sequence phase, concentrating carbon at the surface via magnetic levitation.
Core hydrogen burning via the CNO cycle has processed the outer envelope, which was recently exposed by pulsations.
Massive stellar winds have stripped the hydrogen and CNO-processed nitrogen layers, exposing core helium-burning products.
A recent thermal pulse in a degenerate carbon-oxygen core has driven extreme mixing into the outer atmosphere.

questions.question: The Yarkovsky effect causes a long-term secular drift in the semi-major axis of small asteroids ( kilometer-scale). Which parameter primarily determines whether an asteroid's orbit expands or contracts over time?
options: The geometric albedo contrast between the northern and southern hemispheres
The orbital eccentricity around the Sun
The ratio of solar radiation pressure force to central gravitational force
The sense of rotation (prograde vs. retrograde) relative to its orbital motion direction

questions.question: In astronomical spectropolarimetry utilizing the Zeeman effect, which Stokes parameter measurement across an absorption line profile is directly proportional to the line-of-sight (longitudinal) magnetic field strength?
options: Stokes Q
Stokes V
Stokes I
Stokes U
